spec.claim_summary: Long BTC on 4-hour Supertrend flip to uptrend with ATR stop, half closed at 0.75R with stop moved to breakeven and remainder exited on flip to downtrend.
assumptions: BTCUSD mapped to Binance spot equivalent BTCUSDT for testing.
Supertrend settings not stated, so defaults of ATR length 10 and multiplier 3 used with exit mirroring entry; both listed as free parameters.
ATR stop multiplier not stated, so 2 x ATR(14) at the signal bar assumed; multiplier listed as free parameter.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: closing only half the position at 0.75 risk/reward left out; take_profit_r omitted so the runner to the Supertrend flip is not capped at 0.75R.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: moving the stop loss to breakeven after the 0.75R half-close left out; the original ATR stop is retained for the full holding period.
Supertrend flip encoded as close crossing Supertrend on bar close, filled at next open per engine convention.
Backtest window 2020-01-02 to 2023-01-05 is test window only, not part of the rule; recorded in claimed.

evidence.quote: you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a downtrend to a uptrend, you enter into a long position.
Once Supertrend changes from a uptrend to a downtrend, you close the other half of the initial long position.
The stop loss will be defined by the atr stop loss

audit_majors: take_profit_r: Claim requires 'first profit will be of 0.75 risk/reward ratio where half position will be closed'. Spec sets take_profit_r null and holds full position to Supertrend flip, omitting the 0.75R partial take.
stop_atr_mult: Claim requires 'When this happens, you move the stop loss to break even'. Spec retains original ATR stop for full holding period and omits the breakeven move after 0.75R.
